name: Kiro Workflow Prompts
headline: kiro-workflow-prompts: Your AI Development
short_description: Comprehensive prompt collection for AI agents implementing Kiro IDE's spec-driven development workflow - from requirements to implementation.
author: wirelessr

sections.overview:
The kiro-workflow-prompts skill offers a comprehensive collection of prompts designed specifically for AI agents that implement Kiro IDE's spec-driven development workflow. This skill guides users through the entire process from requirements gathering to implementation, making it an invaluable resource for developers and product managers looking to enhance their AI automation capabilities. By leveraging this skill, teams can ensure that their AI agents are aligned with project specifications, leading to more efficient development cycles. One of the key benefits of using kiro-workflow-prompts is the ability to streamline the development process. While specific time savings are currently unknown, the structured approach provided by this skill can significantly reduce the time spent on drafting and refining prompts. This efficiency is particularly beneficial for teams operating in fast-paced environments where every minute counts. By utilizing these prompts, users can focus more on the creative aspects of development rather than getting bogged down in the details. This skill is ideal for intermediate-level developers, product managers, and AI practitioners who are looking to improve their workflow automation. It is especially relevant for teams that are already familiar with Kiro IDE and wish to integrate AI agent skills into their existing processes. The prompts can be used in various scenarios, such as automating testing procedures, generating documentation, or even creating user interfaces, all of which enhance productivity and ensure consistency across projects. Implementation of the kiro-workflow-prompts skill is straightforward and can be completed in approximately 30 minutes. Users should have a basic understanding of Kiro IDE and its functionalities to maximize the benefits of this skill. By incorporating this skill into an AI-first workflow, teams can enhance their automation capabilities, ultimately leading to a more agile and responsive development environment.
The Code Review Automation feature aims to streamline the code review process by automating routine tasks and providing AI-assisted suggestions for improvements.

sections.usage:
```
Generate a detailed technical specification for a [FEATURE] in Kiro IDE's spec-driven development workflow. Include [REQUIREMENTS] and [CONSTRAINTS]. Structure the output as a markdown document with sections for: Overview, Functional Requirements, Non-Functional Requirements, Dependencies, and Acceptance Criteria. Ensure the specification is detailed enough for a developer to implement without additional clarification.
```
